clause: All personal data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption standard.
evidence: Database backup archive (backup-2024-02-09.tar.gz) stored in S3 was found to use AES-128 encryption. Audit logs show migration was scheduled but not completed.
aiExplanation: The violation occurs because the backup storage configuration uses legacy AES-128 encryption. While AES-128 provides substantial security, the policy explicitly requires AES-256 for compliance with stricter data protection standards. Recommend running the encryption upgrade script and verifying all backup destinations.

clause: Multi-factor authentication must be enabled for all privileged accounts.
evidence: 3 service accounts (svc-deploy, svc-ci, svc-monitor) had MFA disabled. These accounts have elevated permissions for production deployments.
aiExplanation: Service accounts with deployment and CI/CD access represent significant privilege escalation vectors. MFA enforcement for these accounts prevents credential compromise from single-factor attacks. The accounts have been migrated to hardware token MFA.

clause: Security incidents must be reported to the SOC within 15 minutes of discovery.
evidence: Phishing attempt reported 47 minutes after employee received suspicious email. Initial ticket created in general IT queue instead of security incident channel.
aiExplanation: Delayed reporting reduces SOC's ability to contain and investigate. The 32-minute delay allowed potential lateral movement. Recommend implementing automated alerts from email gateway to create incident tickets directly.

clause: Confidential information must not be shared outside authorized channels.
evidence: Product roadmap document shared via external file-sharing link without access expiration. Link was accessible for 6 days before discovery.
aiExplanation: External sharing without time-bound access creates extended exposure window. The document contained unreleased feature details. DLP policy has been updated to block roadmap files from external sharing.

clause: Password complexity must enforce minimum 12 characters with mixed case, numbers, and symbols.
evidence: Legacy customer portal (portal.legacy.example.com) still accepts 8-character minimum passwords. New main portal enforces 12 characters.
aiExplanation: Dual authentication standards create inconsistency. The legacy portal serves 2% of customers but represents technical debt. Migration plan to deprecate legacy portal by Q2 recommended.
